name: LOX DB
description: Predictable-memory C99 database with key-value, time-series and small relational engines, optional WAL recovery, and direct installation from PlatformIO or the Arduino Library Manager.

name: LOX Budget
description: A caller-owned admission controller returns an explicit allow, degrade, defer or deny decision before work starts.

name: LOX Sequence
description: A heap-free step sequencer writes CRC-protected checkpoints and computes a conservative recovery verdict on boot.

name: LOX Perm
description: A header-only evaluator qualifies inputs, latches denials, records first-out state and supports controlled bypass metadata.

name: LOX Alarm
description: A deterministic alarm lifecycle adds delays, latching, acknowledge, shelving and portable snapshots to caller-supplied conditions.

name: LOX Boot
description: A C99 bootloader core provides A/B state, UART update transport and adapter boundaries.

name: LOX Dust
description: A portable object store registers fixed objects, computes deterministic layout and exposes format, mount, propose, check and repair operations.

name: LOX Guard
description: Guard Blocks wrap documented host-tested execution paths, record evidence and route failures to configured policy actions.

name: LOX Sort
description: A stateless dispatcher selects among eligible C99 algorithms using explicit constraints and an offline profile.

name: microfsm
description: A table-driven finite-state-machine engine keeps states, events and actions explicit.

name: microres
description: Caller-owned retry, circuit-breaker and token-bucket primitives provide explicit resilience policy.

name: microconf
description: Validated schemas and a canonical two-slot format keep data caller-owned and bounded.

name: microlog
description: A small logging component routes structured records through caller-controlled storage and sinks.

name: microsh
description: A fixed-capacity shell parses ASCII commands and calls registered argc/argv handlers.

name: microcbor
description: A zero-allocation encoder/decoder implements a definite-length RFC 8949 subset.

name: micoring
description: A fixed-capacity copy-based ring uses caller-owned storage, with optional constrained SPSC atomic mode.

name: microtimer
description: A fixed-capacity manager fires caller callbacks from explicit tick calls.

name: microbus
description: A small event bus copies payload bytes and supports synchronous publish or bounded deferred dispatch.

name: MicroNet
description: A C99 node library provides peers, groups, publish/update/request flows and custom traffic over platform adapters.

name: µMesh
description: C99 PHY, MAC, network and optional power modules provide discovery, routing and retry behavior.

name: microboot
description: A boot-history manager detects crash loops and advises normal, recovery or factory mode.

name: microflash
description: A no-heap abstraction provides partition-relative I/O, counters and explicit NOR alignment contracts.

name: microhealth
description: A caller-owned monitor evaluates registered metrics and reports documented state changes.

name: microassert
description: A caller-owned assert/panic context supports severities, hooks and bounded copied history.

name: microcrypt
description: C99 cryptographic primitives: SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, AES-128, AES-128-CBC and AES-128-GCM with AEAD, AAD and secure-clearing helpers.

name: microdh
description: A focused RFC 7748 X25519 library derives public keys and rejects all-zero shared results in its checked API.

name: microtest
description: A single-header framework provides assertions, suites, fixtures, filtering and custom output.

name: microwdt
description: A software watchdog tracks caller-owned task deadlines and reports late or starved transitions.

name: cguard
description: Header-only result types and optional compiler-backed scope guards make status and ownership transitions visible.

name: defer.h
description: A single header uses the GNU/Clang cleanup attribute to run registered callbacks at normal lexical scope exit.

name: iotspool
description: A persistent store-and-forward queue appends messages before delivery and recovers pending records after restart.

name: IronFamily.FileEngine
description: A monorepo develops active ICFG, ILOG and IUPD engines with portable C99 direction plus .NET host, vector and parity support.

name: MCU Malloc Tracker
description: A diagnostic C library intercepts allocation calls, keeps static tracking tables and writes deterministic binary snapshots for offline decoding.

name: microota
description: A heap-free callback-driven core validates image metadata and read-back CRC before requesting a durable platform commit.

name: num8
description: A fixed 12,500,064-byte file uses one bit per possible value for constant-time membership operations.

name: NUM8-LUP
description: Legacy batch and recommended async sender/receiver protocols encode ADD/REMOVE operations, acknowledgements and retransmissions.

name: nvlog
description: A C99 linear or ring record buffer binds to a caller HAL and exposes format, mount, append and iteration flows.

name: panicdump
description: A retained-RAM library commits a fixed 192-byte CRC-protected dump and exports it for offline decoding.

name: safemath
description: A header-only bool-returning API checks size addition, subtraction, multiplication, offsets and alignment without changing output on failure.

name: Basalt.NET
description: A .NET durable job, scheduling and static-workflow engine with embedded storage or SQL Server backends, retry and idempotent enqueue, leases, fencing, crash recovery and a separate WPF management dashboard.

name: Nexum
description: An experimental programmable communication fabric built around a deterministic execution primitive and explicit bounded state transitions, composed into graphs through caller-provided FIFO storage.

name: ImplicitNet
description: An experimental, allocation-free C17 library that computes mappings, dimension-based neighbors, deterministic next hops and reversible state updates directly from compact state, without materializing the graph.

name: Compost
description: An experimental deterministic artificial-life simulator and complex-systems research project. Autonomous mathematical organisms consume binary input as FOOD, maintain internal state, energy and metabolism, grow structural bodies, hold territory, reproduce, die and compete for resources.

name: Axiom One
description: A dependency-free C99 static library of 22 focused deterministic primitives. Its ONE modules keep state with the caller, use no heap, timers, callbacks or I/O, and expose a plain C API that can be included as one umbrella header or as narrow module headers.

name: GrayGyre
description: An allocation-free, table-free C primitive maps indices with a self-inverse Gray-code shear, spreading local neighbours across configured logical cells while retaining an exact inverse through the same mapping call.

name: SkipSpace
description: A heap-free traversal primitive represents each prefix with compact sufficient state, counts valid continuations using bounded saturating arithmetic, and lets the caller visit or skip an entire subtree without materialising the search tree.

name: Micro-toolkit
description: An integration repository documents nine core micro libraries, migration notes and a multi-library sensor-node example.

name: LOX DB Pro
description: LOX DB Pro is a commercially licensed, pick-and-choose set of independent C modules delivered as CMake targets in the loxdb namespace. The public repository documents integration-facing contracts; implementation, source code and proprietary know-how remain private.

name: LOXC
description: Pure C99, MIT trainable frequency-optimized text codec with v2 and matrix-based v3 formats, including HIER4/HIER8 nested matrices.

name: EquiShift
description: Deterministic C11 primitives for safe constraint-preserving transfers on embedded systems, with caller-owned state, checked arithmetic and exact sequence restoration.
